title: Bangkok map: Wat Arun, smaller pins, and zoom on every map
kaylee: The Bangkok map now shows Wat Arun on the Thonburi bank, so it looks like Bangkok at a glance. It's scenery only, so tapping it does nothing. The kites are gone and the old town is back the way it was, and the two place pins are 40% smaller. On every Thailand map she can pinch in (iPad and iPhone) or pinch on a Mac trackpad or scroll, up to 2.5 times closer, toward the spot under her fingers.
questions: Is 2.5x closer the right limit, or should it stop sooner?
Does Wat Arun look good enough, or should it be bigger?
